reader.edition-search: grep for Edition, CobolVersion, DialectBehavior, IsAvailable and ConstructRegistry in FileRegistry.Register's ::EXT:: arm, ProgramTable.CallProgram/CancelNode and the emitted CloseFiles: the external connector is one per run unit keyed ::EXT::<name> and no edition is read on the call/exit/cancel path (the connector's Edition field governs only file sharing and CLOSE WITH LOCK).
reader.requirement: At 85 calling a program, exiting it (including an initial program's exit, which is an implicit CANCEL) and canceling it leave the open mode, status and position of every file on an external file connector unchanged for every program that describes it.
reader.witnesses-cover: part: g85_f02_06 and 1985-GR-X_5_2_4-8 cover a sequential external file read by a non-initial callee; not covered: relative dynamic access, an initial callee (implicit CANCEL at exit), an explicit CANCEL of a describing program, a callee that opens the external file and returns it open

probes.printed: MAIN F MF01 00 / IW OPEN F 00 / IW REC1 00 / MAIN XS 00 / MAIN REC2 00 / IW OPEN F 00 / IW REC3 00 / MAIN REC4 00 / NW / MAIN REC4 10 / MAIN F MF02 00 (run gr8a-001, MATCH)
probes.expected: the initial callee IW opens the external relative file (after a 47 on the unopened file) and returns it open and positioned; its implicit CANCEL does not close it; the next IW entry reads on from the caller's position; an explicit CANCEL of NW, which describes the file, leaves it open (the next READ is AT END, 10)

reader.notes: Both witnesses MATCH at 85. An EXTERNAL FD registers once per run unit under the ::EXT:: key band and a later describer keeps the live connector; CloseFiles closes only internal connectors, so CANCEL and an initial program's exit leave the external file alone.
